are_you_ok.title: Mischief knocks out internet service to several thousand in Kanawha County

you_should_know.title: PSC approves West Virginia-American Water purchase of Lincoln County water utility for $12.9 million
you_should_know.summary: PSC approves WV-American Water purchase of Lincoln County utility serving Kanawha/Boone/Lincoln customers. Regulatory outcome touching local water customers; context worth walking in aware of. Defensible either way.
